question: Identify the top 10 and bottom 10 interest categories based on their highest composition values across all months. For each category, display the time(MM-YYYY), interest name, and the composition value
sql:
WITH interest_max AS (
    SELECT 
        im.interest_id,
        imn.interest_name,
        im.month_year as time,
        im.composition as max_composition
    FROM interest_metrics im
    JOIN interest_map imn ON CAST(im.interest_id AS INTEGER) = imn.id
    WHERE im.composition IS NOT NULL
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY im.interest_id ORDER BY im.composition DESC) = 1
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        time,
        interest_name,
        max_composition,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY max_composition DESC) as global_rank_desc,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY max_composition ASC) as global_rank_asc
    FROM interest_max
)
SELECT 
    time,
    interest_name,
    max_composition
FROM ranked
WHERE global_rank_desc <= 10
   OR global_rank_asc <= 10
ORDER BY 
    CASE WHEN global_rank_desc <= 10 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
    max_composition DESC
